name.zh: 凑够不同成员触发团队加成
name.en: Reach team bonuses with distinct members

summary.zh: 让一个较弱成员也可能成为阵容缺少的最后一块。
summary.en: A weaker recruit can complete a valuable team bonus.

rules.zh: 单位带有阵营或职业标签，场上符合条件的不同成员达到门槛时触发团队效果。玩家在个人强度、标签数量和上场名额间取舍；界面应说明缺谁、差几个，以及换人会失去哪档效果。
rules.en: Units carry faction or class tags. Enough distinct eligible members activate a team effect. Balance individual strength, tag counts and roster slots, with clear feedback on missing members and bonuses lost by a swap.

loop.en: Choose a tag completion or a stronger unit
Activate or lose a threshold bonus

decisions.zh: 换上弱单位凑出团队加成，是否比单独的强单位更值？
decisions.en: Is a weak unit that completes a bonus worth more than a stronger standalone unit?

decisions.zh: 追求一条高档加成，还是多条低档加成？
decisions.en: Pursue one high threshold or several smaller bonuses?

effect.zh: 间隔大意味着更长的投入期，成型前可能更弱。
effect.en: Wider gaps require longer investment and a weaker transition.

effect.zh: 只惠及同类更强调专精，惠及全队更鼓励混搭。
effect.en: Tag-only benefits encourage specialization; teamwide effects support mixing.

observation.zh: 系统参考图：棋盘上的单位与备战席可见；商店、利息与公共选秀面板没有显示。
observation.en: System reference: Units on the board and bench are visible; shop, interest and shared-draft panels are not shown. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 英雄特质按上场的相关成员激活不同档位效果，选人时要同时考虑单体能力与特质组合。
implementation.en: Champion traits activate at roster thresholds, making recruitment a balance between individual abilities and trait combinations.

cases.sourceLabel: Official developer design article — Riot Games

observation.zh: 系统参考图：战斗棋盘旁显示联盟与伤害信息；这张图没有打开商店。
observation.en: System reference: Alliance and damage information appear beside the combat board; the shop is not open. See the linked text source for the rules.

implementation.zh: 英雄的联盟标签形成搭配，满足人数要求后获得联盟加成；招募方向会随当前英雄改变。
implementation.en: Hero alliances grant bonuses when their membership requirements are met, steering recruitment around the current roster.

contrast.zh: 云顶之弈用特质组织阵容，刀塔霸业用联盟组织；具体门槛与奖励不同，核心共同点是用有限席位凑规则条件。
contrast.en: TFT uses traits and Underlords alliances; their thresholds and rewards differ, but both make roster slots satisfy rule conditions.

combination.zh: 组合提案：能力槽位同样有限，玩家必须在装备强力单体能力与携带补足团队标签的徽章之间选择。
combination.en: Design proposal: limited ability slots force a choice between a strong personal skill and an emblem that completes a team tag.

setup.zh: 场上已有两名工匠，三名可让全队获得护盾。
setup.en: Two artisans are deployed; three would grant the team a shield.

action.zh: 换下高伤害佣兵，放入第三名工匠。
action.en: Replace a high-damage mercenary with a third artisan.

result.zh: 护盾生效，但单体输出下降。
result.en: The shield activates while direct damage falls.

next.zh: 若敌人伤害很低，就考虑换回佣兵加快结束。
next.en: Against low damage, consider restoring the mercenary to end fights faster.

firstStep.zh: 六名单位、两个标签、一个人数门槛，用数字结算战斗即可。
firstStep.en: Use six units, two tags and one threshold; resolve combat numerically.

pitfall.zh: 标签与例外太多会把决策变成记忆考试。
pitfall.en: Too many tags and exceptions turn decisions into memorization.

test.zh: 玩家会不会为补门槛保留看似较弱的单位？
test.en: Do players keep a seemingly weak unit to complete a threshold?
